Gwalior, Dated: 18.12.2017
Shri S.S. Bansal , Advocate for petitioner.
Shri R.B.S. Tomar, Advocate for the respondent.
I.A. No. 14713/17, an application for condonation of delay in filing the present review petition is taken up, considered and allowed for the reasons mentioned therein.
Delay of 1073 days in filing the present review petition is condoned.

The present petition seeks review of the final order dated 01.10.2014 passed in W.P. No.
7677/2012(PIL).
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard on the question of admission.

The solitary contention raised by learned counsel for the review petitioner is by pointing an error apparent on the face of record with reference to the direction contained in para 20(iii) of the order under review which reads thus:
20.

In view of the aforesaid discussion, the writ petition is disposed of with the following directions:
(I) The State Government is directed to appoint Designated Officer, Food Commissioner and Food Analyst in accordance with the provisions of the Act of 2006 and the rules made thereunder.

(II) The Union of India is further directed to provide financial assistance to the State Government for establishment of Food Laboratory and upgradation of Food Laboratories in accordance with law dated 20.12.2012 and 09.01.2013, so the existing food laboratories may be accredited by the National Accreditation Board.
(III) The Union of India is further directed to make financial assistance available to the State for the establishment of 10 Divisional Food Laboratories.

By referring to the above, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this Court fell in error apparent on the face of the record by directing the UOI to make financial assistance available for establishment of 10 Divisional Food Laboratories.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the UOI that the above said direction is based on a mere proposal made by the State while seeking financial Union Of India Department Of Fodd And ... vs Sambhagiye Nagrik Upbhokta ... on 18 December, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110029575/

entities.text: Food Safety and Standard Act 2006(the Act of 2006
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the rival parties and having perused the Act of 2006, This Court could not lay its hands on any statutory provision under the Act or the rules providing for establishment of food laboratories at divisional level.

It appears that the said direction is solely based on the proposal moved by the State to the Union of India while seeking financial assistance for establishment of food laboratories which function lies within the domain of UOI.

In view of the above, this Court is of the considered opinion that an error apparent on the face of record has occurred to the extent the order under review directs for establishment of a particular number of food laboratories.

Consequently, the order under review dated 01.10.2014 is amended by exercising the power of review by substituting the direction contained in para 20(iii) of the said order with the following directions:
(iii) The UOI is further directed to make financial assistance available to the State of M.P. for establishment of Food Laboratories in the State of M.P. in such number which satisfies the statutory requirements under the Act of 2006 and the rules framed thereunder.
To the extent indicated above, the present review petition stands allowed.

(Sheel Nagu) (Ashok Kumar Joshi)
